_what: What this repo publishes from the project. Each copy maps a project folder onto a plugin's skill folder; 'exclude' lists the project files that stay in the project (case work, sample models, run logs, third-party bulk data), 'keep' re-admits files an exclude would catch. Patterns are fnmatch globs on paths relative to the project folder named in 'project'. Read by tools/refresh_copies.py and tools/verify_copies.py. Decided 2026-10-21: the repo holds the skills, the tools and the foundation (domain packs, references, checks), not the samples and work. 'rewrite' lists find -> replace pairs applied, in order, to every published text file (the extensions in 'text_files'): the project layout's skill paths and the engine's old name. The personal ones (the maintainer's folder paths, the name of their other project) are applied first, from tools/publish_rewrites.local.json, which git ignores so the strings it hides are never published; the copy tools stop without it. Decided 2026-10-21 for the public release.

why.vendor/*: third-party tools under their own licences (GPL-3.0, Apache-2.0), 465 MB: listed in plugins/asset-enhancement-engine/VENDOR.md
why.packs/human/base_female_torso/*: a sample model (the woman2 torso, versions v1-v12), not engine foundation
why.packs/human/template/*: MakeHuman's body template data (99 MB); tools/class_template_fetch.py fetches it
why.log/*: run logs, plans, proposals and the maintainer's notes; the skill reads only METHOD.md (its teaching log) and TOOLMAKING.md (the tool index)

rewrite.why: in a plugin install the companion skills are separate plugins, not sibling folders
the engine's public name (decided 2026-10-21); the project keeps its old skill name
